content.short: Capstone Disassembler is an open-source protocol for reverse engineering EVM bytecode.
content.description: Capstone Disassembler is an open-source disassembly engine designed for binary analysis and reverse engineering in the security community. It enables developers to reverse engineer raw bytecode into a human-readable representation, simplifying the task of understanding underlying issues and program behavior. The project is supported by an active team of contributors who continually update Capstone Disassembler to improve usability and intuitiveness for users.
